The currency pair is trading decisively below its 200-period moving average at 1.1405, while the EMA20 has broken beneath the EMA50, confirming an established downtrend. Ichimoku indicators compound this bearish narrative: price resides below the cloud with a negative Tenkan-Kijun crossover, and the cloud structure itself is bearish with the B-line above the A-line, suggesting limited near-term support.

The momentum setup reinforces conviction. RSI at 34.1 indicates oversold conditions without yet reaching extremes, while MACD histogram at negative 1.1377 confirms sustained selling pressure. Entry at 1.1368 offers favorable risk-reward, with a tight 24-pip stop loss targeting recent resistance at 1.1392 and a 1:1.8 risk-adjusted profit target at 1.1324.

The primary catalyst appears macro-driven, likely reflecting broader USD strength or eurozone economic concerns. Key invalidation occurs above 1.1392, which would negate the downtrend confirmation and require position exit. The setup warrants execution pending no material overnight data surprises.
